content: v-lazy-image (npm, latest 2.1.1) is a lightweight, dependency-light Vue lazy-image component using IntersectionObserver, compatible with Vue 2.6. vue-lazyload (npm, latest 3.0.0) is a more feature-rich alternative (directive-based, supports Vue 2) but is less actively maintained. For this project's scale (4 project cards + overlay media), a hand-rolled IntersectionObserver directive or native loading=lazy is simpler than adding either dependency.
